name: Invisible text instruction
description: Instructions hidden using CSS to make text invisible to humans but readable by agents. Any of the hiding styles is flagged wherever it appears, with one structural tag-name exception: a start tag whose name is exactly an image, input, meta, source, track, embed, line break or rule tag, or a frame or a script tag closed at once, followed by whitespace, a slash or the end of the tag, none of which holds text. A name that only starts like one of these is another element and is flagged, and so is a link tag. What the attributes say is never read, except that a frame with a srcdoc is flagged. Any other hidden element is flagged, including hidden interface text such as a closed cookie dialog.
